title: RAMPS on Arduino Mega 2560 (ATmega2560)
description: RAMPS 1.3/1.4/1.6 shield on an Arduino Mega 2560: ATmega2560 at 16 MHz, serial 250000 baud over the Mega's USB-serial chip, flashed with avrdude (wiring/STK500v2 bootloader).
serial_usb: USB-serial via the Mega's ATmega16U2 as /dev/ttyACM0, 250000 baud.
notes: Compile-only: built in a sandbox with Klipper v0.13.0; never flashed or run on this board by the author.
avrdude flags copy Klipper's src/avr/Makefile flash rule: -p<mcu> -c<protocol> -P<port> -D -Uflash:w:<hex>:i (protocol 'wiring' for atmega2560 per src/avr/Kconfig).
Close anything using the serial port (Klipper, Cura, a monitor) before flashing.
sources: Klipper v0.13.0 src/avr/Kconfig (AVRDUDE_PROTOCOL) and src/avr/Makefile (flash rule)
